{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fest military''' was the armed forces of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Fest collaborationist government|government]]. They were forced to take over the duties of the [[Fest police force]] after the latter suffered a rash of desertions in the face of constant attacks from the [[Fest Alliance Forces]].
